title: 4 Ways to Build an AI Agent
description:
What's the best way to build an AI agent? It depends how much you want to build yourself, and it breaks into four tiers. At the top: no-code platforms, where you build by filling out forms and dragging blocks, no programming needed. 

Below that: low-code tools, where you write parts of the agent on a visual canvas.  Then agent harnesses, where you install a complete, powerful agent and customize it. And at the bottom: full code, where you write the whole thing yourself in a language like Python. 

Pick the tier that matches your skills and goals.

#techwithtim #ai #aiengineer
